verdict.rationale: Asana documents an official MCP server and an Asana app in Claude. Through these, AI assistants can answer natural-language questions such as "Find all my incomplete tasks due this week" and generate summaries from Asana data, which covers the core of asking AI about workspace content. However, the answering AI is an external client, there is no evidence of a native in-Asana Q&A experience, and nothing mentions answers coming with citations or source links. Missing for 10: documented citations or source attribution in answers, a native in-product AI Q&A or search feature, evidence of instant-answer behavior, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can ask AI a question and get an instant answer with citations from my workspace content

citations.quote: Generate reports and summaries based on Asana data
The Asana app in Claude brings your work graph directly into Claude conversations
Read tools return data from your workspace without making any changes.
